findings.highlight: the perverted behavior you just exhibited
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の行為の変態性に危機感を持ってな
findings.explanation: Haruki says he stopped because he became alarmed at the perversity of his own vacuum-cleaner play. The translation makes him accuse Chiaki of the perverted behavior.
findings.japanese: 「…ちょっと自分の行為の変態性に危機感を持ってな」
findings.todokanai: "…Shouldn't you feel a little concerned about the perverted behavior you just exhibited?"

findings.highlight: she would probably do something horribly wrong with the vacuum cleaner
findings.evidenceJa: 色んな場所を掃除機で責めてしまいそうだった
findings.explanation: Haruki fears that if this continues, he will torment various parts of Chiaki's body with the vacuum while wearing a sadistic smile. The translation again assigns the action to Chiaki and turns Haruki's arousal into hers.
findings.japanese:
このまま放っておくと、
色んな場所を掃除機で責めてしまいそうだった。
…嗜虐心に満ちた笑顔とともに。
findings.todokanai: If I just let her be, she would probably do something horribly wrong with the vacuum cleaner… with an aroused expression as well…

findings.highlight: I'm not bored to the point where I'll believe in dreams like that
findings.evidenceJa: そんなヒモの世迷い言を信じるほど、俺は夢見がちな行き遅れじゃないの
findings.explanation: Haruki jokingly casts Chiaki as a freeloading kept man and himself as a dreamy spinster past marriageable age who should not believe such promises. The translation deletes the inverted gender-role joke and substitutes boredom.
findings.japanese:
「そんなヒモの世迷い言を信じるほど、
俺は夢見がちな行き遅れじゃないの」
findings.todokanai: "I'm not bored to the point where I'll believe in dreams like that."

findings.highlight: if we both agree to it, then the limit can be ignored
findings.evidenceJa: 自分だけじゃなく、相手の両手でもＯＫという規制解除も増えた
findings.explanation: Their truth signal is limited to once per day, but the rule has expanded so that either one's own two hands or the other person's two hands may be pressed in place. The translation invents mutual agreement as a way to ignore the daily limit, losing the physical cue.
findings.japanese:
一日に一度だけって制限を付けたけど。
自分だけじゃなく、相手の両手でもＯＫという
規制解除も増えたけど。
findings.todokanai: We've agreed on a limit of only doing it once per day. But if we both agree to it, then the limit can be ignored.

findings.highlight: she's only saying those words without actually acting on them
findings.evidenceJa: そんな台詞、ただ口に出してないだけで
findings.explanation: Haruki admits internally that he already feels what Chiaki promises to make him say; he simply has not spoken it aloud. The translation instead dismisses Chiaki's words as speech unsupported by action, reversing both speaker and emotional truth.
findings.japanese:
それにそんな台詞、
ただ口に出してないだけで…
findings.todokanai: Moreover, she's only saying those words without actually acting on them…

findings.highlight: Because the cat that I decided to never abandon again confesses her feelings all of a sudden.
findings.evidenceJa:
だから、もう自分は捨てられないと悟った飼い猫は、
そんなふうに、突然自分をさらけ出す。
findings.explanation: The pet cat herself realizes she can no longer be abandoned, while the English makes this chiefly Haruki's decision never to abandon her.
findings.japanese:
だから、もう自分は捨てられないと悟った飼い猫は、
そんなふうに、突然自分をさらけ出す。
findings.todokanai: Because the cat that I decided to never abandon again confesses her feelings all of a sudden.

findings.highlight: It might take some time, but I'll be here for you
findings.evidenceJa: 時間をかけて、春希を染め上げてあげるからね
findings.explanation: Chiaki promises to take her time dyeing or reshaping Haruki in her own colors until the wound of memory closes. The translation replaces that possessive, character-specific intention with generic supportive presence.
findings.japanese:
「時間をかけて、春希を染め上げてあげるからね。
…思い出の傷、塞がるまで」
findings.todokanai: "It might take some time, but I'll be here for you, Haruki. …Until your wounds heal, that is."

findings.highlight: the three people that fell apart
findings.evidenceJa: あたしがぶち壊した三人
findings.explanation: Chiaki explicitly calls them the three people she smashed apart. The translation removes her agency and says only that the trio fell apart, weakening the purpose of her keeping the knife.
findings.japanese:
「あたしが憧れた三人。
あたしがぶち壊した三人を忘れないために。
…二度とこのナイフを使わないために」
findings.todokanai: "For the sake of the three people who I admired. For the sake of never forgetting about the three people that fell apart. …And for the sake of never using this knife again."

findings.highlight: In order for her to remain by my side
findings.evidenceJa: ずっと、俺がこいつの側にいられるように
findings.explanation: Haruki keeps Chiaki dependent so that he can always remain by her side. The translation says he does it so that she remains by his, reversing the dependency he confesses to engineering.
findings.japanese: ずっと、俺がこいつの側にいられるように。
findings.todokanai: In order for her to remain by my side.

findings.highlight: I never plan on changing myself
findings.evidenceJa: これからも演技を続ける
findings.explanation: Chiaki says she has recovered and will continue acting as though she has not changed, forever making Haruki lament that apparent fact. The translation turns the performed unchanged persona into a sincere refusal ever to change.
findings.japanese:
『だけど、これからも演技を続ける。
あたしはちっとも変わってないって、
ずっと春希を嘆かせてやるから』
findings.todokanai: "But even so, I'll keep my act up. I never plan on changing myself, I'll keep making you sigh."
